# Live-provider fixtures

These are project-authored synthetic fixtures, distributed under the repository's
Apache-2.0 license. No user media or third-party recording is included. Files are
stored as base64 so tests can use the same inline representation as MCP callers.

- `shapes.png.base64`: 480 × 260 RGB PNG. A red square is on the left and a blue
  circle is on the right, with black labels `RED 42` and `BLUE`. Deterministically
  drawn by `tools/generate_e2e_fixtures.py` using Python's standard library.
- `shapes.wav.base64`: mono 16-bit PCM speech generated by eSpeak NG's `en-us`
  voice at 145 words/minute, using Debian Bookworm's eSpeak NG 1.51 package in the pinned image
  recorded in the generator. The original text is: **“The red square is next to
  the blue circle.”** The WAV is normalized to a regular header with actual sizes.
  eSpeak NG is only a fixture-generation tool, not a build/runtime dependency.

Regenerate the image with `python3 tools/generate_e2e_fixtures.py`; use `--audio`
to regenerate speech too (requires Docker and package-download access). The
checked-in audio lets tests run on any supported platform without synthesis tools.
